visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses is holding a gold and white bottle of skincare product close to the camera. She is smiling warmly. The background is a brightly lit indoor office setting with glass partitions. (2) The camera angle shifts slightly as she pumps a small amount of bright orange-colored cream onto her palm. She wears a striped shirt and a simple ring on her finger. (3) She uses her fingers to gently apply and tap the orange cream onto her left cheek and then her forehead. Her expression is focused as she demonstrates the proper application technique. (4) A large 3D digital countdown animation (number 2, then 1) appears in front of her face, temporarily obscuring her. (5) She removes the animation to reveal her glowing, clear skin. She makes heart gestures with her hands towards the camera, looking pleased with the results. (6) The video ends with a white background showing the brand logo and name.
